item.title: How Modern CX Tools Reduce Call Center Churn
item.summary: Call center staff churn creates massive operational headaches for managers across Australia. High turnover drains company budgets, lowers team morale, and damages key service scores. Modern customer experience software offers practical solutions to keep agents engaged and satisfied.
